summary: Bearer resists the next source that would wound, kill, apply a State or otherwise harm them or their carried equipment; not their own effects.

effects.subject: bearer
effects.note: All effects of the next source that would inflict a wound, death, a State, or negatively affect the bearer or their carried equipment. Does not trigger against effects cast by the bearer.

restrictions.note: Does not trigger against effects cast by the bearer.

termination.note: Resistant to the next source only.

clarifications.text: Covers everything from the source: wounds, death, States and any negative effect on the bearer or their carried equipment.
Does not trigger against effects cast by the bearer themselves.

open_questions: Whether the Enchantment is removed once it triggers is not stated in its own text; the general rule that Enchantments with a definite number of uses are removed when the last use is expended (it names Blessing Against Harm) probably applies.
